031/**
032 * Wrapper class around a {@link XMLStreamReader}.
033 *
034 * <p>
035 * The purpose is to encapsulate the reader with the {@link ParserPipe} object so that it can be retrieved for
036 * debugging purposes.
037 *
038 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
039 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/XmlSupport">XML Basics</a>
040 * </ul>
041 */
042@SuppressWarnings({
043   "resource" // pipe field is owned by the caller's parser session; the Reader it supplies is consumed by XMLInputFactory and not owned here.
044})
045public class XmlReader implements XMLStreamReader, Positionable {
046
047   private final ParserPipe pipe;
048   private final XMLStreamReader sr;
049
050   /**
051    * Constructor.
052    *
053    * @param pipe The parser input.
054    *    <br>Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
055    * @param validating The value for the {@link XMLInputFactory#IS_VALIDATING} setting.
056    * @param reporter The value for the {@link XMLInputFactory#REPORTER} setting.
057    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (the factory's default reporter is used).
058    * @param resolver The value for the {@link XMLInputFactory#RESOLVER} setting.
059    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (the factory's default resolver is used).
060    * @param eventAllocator The value for the {@link XMLInputFactory#ALLOCATOR} setting.
061    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (the factory's default event allocator is used).
062    * @throws IOException Thrown by underlying I/O.
063    * @throws XMLStreamException Thrown by underlying XML stream.
064    */
065   protected XmlReader(ParserPipe pipe, boolean validating, XMLReporter reporter, XMLResolver resolver, XMLEventAllocator eventAllocator) throws IOException, XMLStreamException {
066      this.pipe = pipe;
067      try {
068         Reader r = pipe.getBufferedReader();
069         var factory = XMLInputFactory.newInstance();
070         factory.setProperty(XMLInputFactory.IS_VALIDATING, validating);
071         factory.setProperty(XMLInputFactory.IS_COALESCING, true);
072         factory.setProperty(XMLInputFactory.IS_REPLACING_ENTITY_REFERENCES, false);
073         factory.setProperty(XMLInputFactory.IS_SUPPORTING_EXTERNAL_ENTITIES, false);
074         // Disable DTD processing unconditionally.  DTD constructs are not needed for data binding, and
075         // keeping them off — regardless of the validating flag — bounds document/entity handling so a
076         // declared internal DTD cannot drive runaway entity expansion.
077         factory.setProperty(XMLInputFactory.SUPPORT_DTD, false);
078         // Belt-and-suspenders: forbid resolving any external DTD/schema on factories that honor these
079         // properties, in case a StAX implementation handles external-entity support inconsistently.
080         if (factory.isPropertySupported(XMLConstants.ACCESS_EXTERNAL_DTD))
081            factory.setProperty(XMLConstants.ACCESS_EXTERNAL_DTD, "");
082         if (factory.isPropertySupported(XMLConstants.ACCESS_EXTERNAL_SCHEMA))
083            factory.setProperty(XMLConstants.ACCESS_EXTERNAL_SCHEMA, "");
084         if (factory.isPropertySupported(XMLInputFactory.REPORTER) && nn(reporter))
085            factory.setProperty(XMLInputFactory.REPORTER, reporter);
086         if (factory.isPropertySupported(XMLInputFactory.RESOLVER) && nn(resolver))
087            factory.setProperty(XMLInputFactory.RESOLVER, resolver);
088         if (factory.isPropertySupported(XMLInputFactory.ALLOCATOR) && nn(eventAllocator))
089            factory.setProperty(XMLInputFactory.ALLOCATOR, eventAllocator);
090      sr = factory.createXMLStreamReader(r);
091      sr.nextTag();
092      pipe.setPositionable(this);
093   } catch (Exception e) {
094      throw castException(IOException.class, e);
095   }
096   }
097
